ideas.pitch: An AI-powered diagnostic triage tool designed for low-connectivity rural health centers in Madhya Pradesh, supporting local languages and offline model caching.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics.
ideas.title: ArogyaNet: Offline-First Rural Health Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the HealthTech track with a hyper-local angle relevant to Madhya Pradesh's rural demographics, satisfying judges looking for real-world impact and high problem-solving approach.

ideas.pitch: A mobile web application using computer vision and local botanical datasets to verify medicinal plants and traditional AYUSH remedies common in central India.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare. Think about diagnostics.
ideas.title: AyurScan: Traditional Herb and Remedy Authenticator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges indigenous regional knowledge with modern AI computer vision, appealing directly to IIIT Bhubaneswar and regional judges who value localized cultural and technical integration.

ideas.pitch: A predictive wait-time and queue management system for district hospitals in Madhya Pradesh to minimize patient congestion and improve healthcare efficiency.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare.
ideas.title: SwasthyaQueue: Predictive OPD Flow Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages statistical modeling and clear operational metrics, taking inspiration from winning regression and forecasting architectures to demonstrate immediate efficiency gains.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight tracking dashboard for state-level distribution of pharmaceuticals, preventing counterfeiting and cold-chain failures in rural primary health centers.
ideas.problem_statement: HealthTech: Build solutions that improve access, quality, or efficiency of healthcare.
ideas.title: MediChain MP: Supply Chain Integrity for Essential Drugs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines log analytics with data visualization similar to winning enterprise analytics entries, offering clear economic and social impact metrics for judges.
